::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 10th 1899  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

My dear [Mrs Sumner](people/person_1381.qmd)
I hope you had the bundle of materials for the April [Mothers in Council](organizations/other_82.qmd) that I sent to Claremont, Rudleston, Manchester on the 31st January, for it is time [Wells Gardiner](organizations/other_114.qmd) had them. If there is nothing to alter, perhaps you would leave them at his office, writing Mothers in Council on them. I only want to add a most excellent book of The Sunday School Institute
[‘Christ in the Catechism’](other_books/otherbook_599.qmd) but that can be done in the proofs.

Here is [Mrs Bartram](people/person_1668.qmd), Ramsgate Vicarage writing to ask leave for their Organist to set to music ‘God Knows’ out of our October number - I suppose there is no objection, but I do not now remember where it came from.

I shall wait to answer till I hear from you.

I have not had [Mrs Guslett](people/person_1669.qmd)’s paper

Yours affectionately
C M Yonge
